# Beehive Strategy

> Forward-Deployed AI Partner for Cross-Border Mid-Market. We sell capability and
> knowledge — metric definition, accuracy accountability, workflow codification, IM
> entry points (WhatsApp / WeChat Work / DingTalk / Feishu / Teams / Telegram) and
> compliant delivery. Deployed in two weeks; HK/GBA mid-market without a CIO.
> Languages: English, Simplified Chinese (简体中文), Traditional Chinese (繁體中文).

## Pricing
- We sell capability and knowledge, NOT software licences, day-rates or training.
- Priced per delivered knowledge asset (metric/dimension dictionary, evaluation set,
  SOP cards, permission & audit-trail matrix, handover pack) — scope flexes by asset
  count rather than discounting the unit price.
- Indicative unit price: SOP cards HK$8-12K each.
- Engagements are scoped per client; contact us for a quote.
